title: MagicMirror_MusicLearningCompanion game package manifest, schema 1
description: manifest.json at the top of every game package. check.py applies these rules and a few the schema cannot say (the folder is named after the id; sdk not newer than the mirror's).

id.description: Reverse-DNS id, lower case, e.g. io.github.yourname.mygame. Also the package's folder name. Never change it: scores are kept under it.

sdk.description: The lowest mirror SDK level the game needs. Today: 1.

sponsor.description: GitHub Sponsors / Ko-fi / Open Collective page. Shown as credit; the mirror takes no money.

license.description: The code licence (SPDX id). MIT is recommended.

artLicense.description: The licence of pictures and sounds (SPDX id). CC BY 4.0 is recommended.

entry.description: The game's QML file, in the top folder.

thumb.description: Tile picture in the package, a PNG shown in a 16:9 tile on the Installed tab: 512 x 288 fits exactly.

cover.description: Portrait cover, 1080 x 1920 PNG. Reserved: checked, not shown yet.

howTo.description: One or two sentences: how to play.

streams.description: What the game reads. The mirror gives the game ONLY these, as mirror.d. Sound and bow only: never the camera, the microphone or the pose.

outputs.description: What the game may ask the mirror to do, besides scoring.

permissions.description: Always empty in sdk 1: no network, no files, no storage.

scoreIds.description: The score names the game uses with mirror.score(). Kept as pkg:<id>:<scoreId>.

levels.description: How many levels the game has (0 = none). Shown as Levels on the game's page.

ageRange.description: [youngest, oldest] player age in years, e.g. [6, 12]. For reviewers and later filtering; not shown yet.

techniques.description: Technique ids from the mirror's etude taxonomy (e.g. rh.spiccato.controlled), so a mode can recommend the game later. May be empty.
